FREE.NAME: Free

CHECKOUT.META_DESCRIPTION: Review your listing fee and record the payment request.
CHECKOUT.TITLE: Complete your order
CHECKOUT.SUBTITLE: Review the details before recording the request. Nothing is charged automatically.
CHECKOUT.NO_GATEWAY_TITLE: Online payment is not live yet
CHECKOUT.NO_GATEWAY_BODY: There is no payment gateway, and this page will never ask for card details. Confirming records an amount owed with a reference number; you then pay by bank transfer and our team confirms it manually.

EXTENSION.TITLE: Extend the listing
EXTENSION.DESCRIPTION: Republishes your expired listing with a full new publication period, measured from the day payment is confirmed rather than from the old expiry date.

FEATURED.TITLE: Feature the listing
FEATURED.DESCRIPTION: Lifts your listing in search results for the paid period. If it is already featured, the new period is added to the days you have left rather than replacing them.

CHECKOUT.CONFIRM_HINT: This records an amount you owe and gives you a reference number. Nothing is charged, and your listing does not change until the transfer is confirmed.
CHECKOUT.ERROR: The request could not be recorded. Check that the listing is yours and that its status allows this, then try again.
CHECKOUT.RECORDED_BODY: The amount is now recorded as outstanding. Your listing has not changed yet; it changes as soon as our team confirms the transfer arrived.
CHECKOUT.ALREADY_PENDING: You already had a request for this service on this listing, and this is the same one. You have not been charged twice.
CHECKOUT.REFERENCE_HINT: Quote this on your transfer — it is how your payment is matched to your listing.
CHECKOUT.STEP_ONE: Contact us for the bank transfer details.
CHECKOUT.STEP_TWO: Make the transfer, quoting the reference number above.
CHECKOUT.STEP_THREE: Once the money is confirmed, the request is applied to your listing and you get a notification.
CHECKOUT.TRANSFER_DETAILS: Bank account details are sent directly and are not published on this page.
CHECKOUT.CONTACT_US: Contact us to complete the transfer
